summary: Verify Space Is Fake research continuations through the actual emitter.
details: The existing community regression now compiles and emits both level-7 continuations through the admitted transformation plan, mutation journal and single emitter under all seven science-selection modes.
Controls assert the emitted ingredients exclude retired space science and retain finite prerequisites and native continuation ownership. Both F210 and F200 adapters pass 354 controlled assertions.
This repository-only regression evidence grants no native, upgrade, ecosystem, multiplayer or release acceptance. Request SIF-01 and exact native qualification remain outstanding.
